concept: THE RECEIPT -- the video reads like the project's own changelog rendered as proof: a hackathon stat, a four-tool diagram, a live terminal invocation, and a star count that visibly keeps climbing, closing on a wordmark that rhymes with the open.
money_shot_note: scene 5 (sparkline + big_number count-up) is the peak: the growth curve draws itself and the numeral lands on 225k+ in the same beat -- the one moment that proves the whole thesis.
transition_strategy: fade-through cuts snapped to the music's onsets via beat_align; the flash scene (6) gets a harder chromatic-tick cut since it's the polarity flip
music_direction: steady build from restrained to driving, matching the energy curve; a lift right before the sparkline lands, drop into the inverted flash beat, settle for quote and close

scenes.intent: establish the project name as the poster frame within the first second, already in motion
scenes.copy_note: ECC / Everything Claude Code -- kinetic per-char headline
scenes.sound_cue: soft whoosh into the first onset

scenes.intent: land the origin economics as a hard stat card -- this wasn't a slow roadmap, it was one sitting
scenes.copy_note: 8 hours. $15,000 in API credits. One hackathon table.

scenes.intent: show the real product: one config, four harnesses -- this is infrastructure, not a prompt pack
scenes.copy_note: diagram draw-on: ECC at center, arrows out to Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenCode
scenes.sound_cue: four sequential ticks as each arrow draws

scenes.intent: prove it runs -- a real agent invocation, typed, not narrated
scenes.copy_note: typed session invoking an ECC subagent, per-line accents

scenes.intent: the peak: the growth curve draws itself and the star count lands on the current number
scenes.copy_note: sparkline from the March baseline to now, big_number count-up landing on 225k+
scenes.sound_cue: rising swell into a landed impact stamp

scenes.intent: the one polarity flip -- spend the contrast budget on the line that matters most
scenes.copy_note: inverted dark field, kinetic word: still climbing.

scenes.intent: step back from the metrics to the human read -- why this stuck
scenes.copy_note: one line on systemizing ten months of daily use into something anyone can run

scenes.intent: close on a composition that visually rhymes with the open for the autoloop
scenes.copy_note: wordmark returns, same layout box as scene 1
